# Beagle v0.25.1

Beagle v0.25.1 repairs the Nix package for the final file-authored, typed-Lisp
language line. It changes package provenance and runtime completeness only; the
language and program-authority boundary frozen in v0.25.0 is unchanged.

## Fixed

- Nix-packaged Native builds now carry the exact source revision into compiler
  receipts even though immutable package sources contain no `.git` metadata.
  Checkout builds continue to derive provenance from their own Git HEAD, and
  malformed, absent, or conflicting revision claims fail closed.
- The packaged runtime now includes `ripgrep`, which the Native build finalizer
  requires while validating generated artifacts.
- Checked-AST reuse now defaults to the writable XDG or user cache instead of
  trying to create cache state inside an immutable packaged source tree.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/tompassarelli/beagle/compare/v0.25.0...v0.25.1
